checks.name: the registry names the LIVE substrate
the domain is bound — observable and actable
it reads the real directory as its world
it tried real actions in the real world to find out what they do
it INDUCED an executable MOVE_FILE operator from what happened
the first attempt did NOT reach the goal straight away
nothing was refuted — MOVE_FILE is still true of this world
IT REPLANNED FROM WHERE THE FILE ACTUALLY WENT AND FINISHED THE JOB
it did not claim to have filed a report into a place that is gone
the file is still somewhere real — nothing was destroyed chasing it
a route that stopped was recorded as WITHDRAWN, not left standing
an unchanged world does not spawn endless replans
